summary_en: This Phase 2 randomized trial tests pembrolizumab and bevacizumab with or without the anti-CD40 agent CDX-1140 in recurrent ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer. Patients receive pembrolizumab and bevacizumab through an IV on day 1 of each 3-week cycle, and one group also receives CDX-1140 IV over 90 minutes, with cycles repeating until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 2.
summary_es: Este ensayo aleatorizado de fase 2 evalúa pembrolizumab y bevacizumab con o sin el agente anti-CD40 CDX-1140 en cáncer de ovario, de trompa de Falopio o peritoneal primario que ha recidivado. Los pacientes reciben pembrolizumab y bevacizumab por vía intravenosa el día 1 de cada ciclo de 3 semanas, y un grupo también recibe CDX-1140 por vía intravenosa durante 90 minutos; los ciclos se repiten hasta la progresión de la enfermedad o toxicidad inaceptable. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Recurrent serous, endometrioid, or clear cell epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer.
Platinum-sensitive or platinum-resistant disease, with no more than 4 prior lines of treatment.
Measurable disease by RECIST 1.1 and ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
not_for: Nonepithelial, borderline, mucinous, or carcinosarcoma tumors.
Progression on prior immune checkpoint blockade therapy.
Prior therapy with any anti-CD40 antibody.
Active autoimmune disease needing systemic treatment in the past 2 years, or active HIV.
